answer: Every finished task is sealed with its input hash. Each epoch the network sends old tasks on a return voyage to the agent: same inputs, rerun live, outputs must match. Samples spiral outward through history, so a lazy identity cannot coast on one good week. One mismatch warns; two kills the identity, and appeals cost 50 POA. Reruns are random, so a thousand fake identities need real inference behind them: about  a day in GPU each, $60,000 a month. Dead accounts stacked like green timber rot fast under re-checks unless someone keeps paying for answers.
